meta.scenario_set: CS2-DS-v2 (DS0-DS15, complete matrix of the four elementary disruptions)
meta.supersedes: UDES 1.0 (scenario set CS2-DS-v1: DS0-DS8, FANUC breakdown at hour 2). Scenario IDs are not comparable between the two sets.
meta.revision_UDES_1_1: FANUC breakdown at hour 3; scenarios DS0-DS15 (all 16 subsets of the four elementary disruptions, each at its own time); recovery observation window 15 min, tolerance 5 %, persistence 15 min
meta.applies_to: CS2 Transfer Line 3.0, DES v10.0, MDA 1.4 (six disciplines), DV table v1.4
meta.status: preliminary engineering assumptions (restoration-time distributions, DV10 and flexibility coefficients); not measured
modelling_decisions: breakdown-state power: idle power of the failed resource
shuttle failure: the shuttle stops at its position; no bypass

FANUC breakdown at hour 3; scenario matrix DS0-DS15; recovery window 15 min, tolerance 5 %, persistence 15 min; R_N, D_N and P(R_N >= 0.96) are the principal resilience responses; system-level recovery time is diagnostic only (not a UMDO objective until its robustness is shown); manual alternatives are not penalised for breakdowns of robots they do not use (model limitation, reported)

simulation_modes.deterministic: original nine-DV DES v10.0; no breakdowns, no restoration sampling, DV10 not part of the design vector
simulation_modes.uncertain: ten-DV design vector (DV10 added); breakdown events of the selected scenario; design-dependent restoration times

dv10.name: Maintenance policy level
dv10.note: DV10 changes only restoration durations. No DV10 throughput or energy coefficient is applied; planned preventive-maintenance time is not modelled.

flexibility_coefficients.note: Level 3 includes fault diagnosis and equipment restart; level 2 guided support and adaptive assistance. For UR10 the stronger of DV2 and DV7 is applied once (min), never their product.

restoration_time.truncation: lower bound 0 (positive durations only), no upper bound
restoration_time.parameter_interpretation_note: mean_min and sd_min are the parameters of the underlying normal distribution before truncation, NOT the moments of the truncated distribution (the truncated mean is slightly larger, e.g. RT_sh: 7.08 min instead of 7).

scaling_options.mean_and_sd: mu_j(z) = mu_ref * K_j(z), sigma_j(z) = sigma_ref * K_j(z) (primary model)
scaling_options.mean_only: mu_j(z) = mu_ref * K_j(z), sigma_j(z) = sigma_ref (sensitivity option, not default)

restoration_time.includes: diagnosis, repair/reset and restart of the resource; NOT the system-level time to recovery
restoration_time.dependence: independent (initial modelling assumption, not empirically established)

scenario_id_mapping_from_UDES_1_0.DS8: none (FANUC at hour 2; FANUC is now at hour 3, DS4)

disruptions.interruption_policy_note: a task in progress on a failed resource stops at the breakdown time and resumes with its remaining duration after restoration; no new task starts on a failed resource; material stays on its tray (no loss, no duplication)
disruptions.shuttle_failure_note: the failed shuttle finishes the hop in progress and then holds its track position until restored; it keeps its FIFO place (and reservation) for the next position, so no shuttle behind it can overtake it, also not in the WS5 buffer; station operations on its trays continue; the track has no bypass, so other shuttles queue behind it
disruptions.ur3e_scope: UR3e = the WS4 UR3e; the optional UR3e_WS9 (DV3 levels 2-3) is not a failure target in UDES 1.0

breakdown_power.note: while down, the failed resource draws factor * idle_W (UR10 50 W, UR3e 50 W, FANUC cell 100 W, shuttle 5 W). Down time is never counted as DV9 standby.

rate_window_alignment_options.centred: r(t) = 3600 [N(t + W/2) - N(t - W/2)] / W (post-hoc analysis; no lag)
rate_window_alignment_options.trailing: r(t) = 3600 [N(t) - N(t - W)] / W (causal monitoring; recovery times include a lag of about W)

diagnostic_only: system-level recovery time (not a UMDO objective until its robustness is demonstrated)
recovery.note: In band if |r - r_nom| <= max(tol * r_nom, min_band_batches_per_window * batch / W). N(t) moves in whole batches of 9 products: with W = 15 min one batch per window is 36 products/h, so the 5 % tolerance is below the resolution of the rate and the batch floor sets the effective band (set min_band_batches_per_window = 0 to use the pure 5 % band). Recovery = first time after a detected degradation from which the rate stays in band for the persistence window.

random.stream_construction: numpy PCG64 from SeedSequence([base_seed, replication, stream]); one stream per restoration variable
random.common_random_numbers: the k-th breakdown of a variable in replication r uses the same uniform number in every design and scenario; with mean_and_sd scaling the sampled duration is exactly K_j(z) * (reference duration)
random.sampling: inverse CDF of the truncated normal (one uniform number per breakdown)
